description_sq: Shesim apartament 2+1 me verande ne zonen e Astirit. Prona ka siperfaqe 110 m2 dhe verande 90 m2. Pozicionohet ne katin e 9-te te nje pallati me ashensor. Apartamenti organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete, nje ballkon dhe nje verande e cila mund te shfrytezohet sipas deshires ose mund te mbyllet dhe te behet pjese e apartamentit. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekore. Per me teper informacion me kontaktoni !
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment with a veranda in the area of ​​Astir. The property has a surface of 110 m2 and a veranda of 90 m2. It is located on the 9th floor of a building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in a living room together with the kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a balcony and a veranda which can be used as desired or can be closed and become part of the apartment. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, contact me!
